svg.title: Plasticity and tearing
svg.desc: Top row, plasticity: a bar at rest is bent by a load, and once released it keeps part of the bend because its rest shape was permanently modified. Bottom row, tearing: a bar is pulled apart, the elements around the crack exceed their failure threshold, and the mass points along the crack are split in two, one copy per side, so the bar separates into two pieces without losing any element.

g.text: Part of the deformation stays permanently.
Plasticity: the rest shape is permanently modified.
Tearing: the topology changes and the body splits.
split mass point (one copy per side)
